description: 2 tactical challenges for White in the Geller Gambit. Play 5.e4! and build the mobile center.

drills.briefExplanation: 5.e4! b5 6.e5 Ne4 7.Bd3 — the roller starts; meet the knight with development.
drills.description: White to play. Black took on c4 — strike with the Geller 5.e4!.
drills.explanation: The Geller Gambit: White sacrifices the c-pawn for a powerful mobile center. After 5.e4! b5 6.e5 White's pawns start rolling — the e5 wedge cramps Black, the bishops will rake the long diagonals, and Black's extra pawn is a weakness, not an asset. Space and time beat material.
drills.name: The Pawn Roller

drills.briefExplanation: 6.e5 Nd5 7.Nxd5 cxd5 — push the pawn, trade the blockader, open the c-file.
drills.description: White to play. Black pushed 5...b5 — advance 6.e5! and trade on d5.
drills.explanation: The Geller in motion: after 5...b5 White plays 6.e5!, and after 6...Nd5 comes 7.Nxd5 cxd5 — White trades the blockader and opens the c-file for the rook. Black's queenside is loosened, the e5 pawn cramps everything, and White's initiative is lasting.
drills.name: Trading the Blockader

name: Geller Gambit — White Tactics
